description: This Java class configures security settings for a Spring Boot application, including CORS configuration, password encoding, authentication management, and security filter chain with JWT integration.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up security, CORS, password encoding, and security filter chain, integrating JWT filter into the security pipeline.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Bean that provides a BCrypt password encoder for hashing passwords.

methods.name: authenticationManager
methods.description: Bean that sets up the authentication manager with a DAO provider using the specified user details service and password encoder.

methods.name: corsConfigurationSource
methods.description: Bean that defines CORS policy, including allowed origins, methods, headers, and credentials.

methods.name: securityFilterChain
methods.description: Method that configures HTTP security, disabling CSRF, setting session management, defining permitted URLs, and adding JWT filter before username-password authentication.
